Refutation is an INPUT, never a discovery: cosine finds nodes that are ALIKE, and a statement and its negation are alike, so nothing detects contradiction — a HAND states it, through chat's literal 'correct: <node_id> <why>' prefix (freeness proved structurally: route() takes nothing but the utterance). trees.refute lands ONE owner-gated update flipping standing to 'refuted' and appending {source, refuter, evidence, at} — invalidate, never delete, with content, vector and birth provenance byte-identical under a whole-row sha256. Six refusals named in ONE pass. The borrow is cairn/ruling's supersession rule, CITED in the charter's entry and proved unimported by an AST walk. The read half is arithmetic and free: the refuted clause sits ABOVE the earned pass-through, so a node earned and then refuted is still uncounted — the one tooth that distinguishes correct placement from incorrect. LIVE FIRE against the real seam and the real store retired a genuine hallucinated backfill (/hex/payback/meter/measure/network_bandwidth) against Akien's own verbatim line; the next crossing returned it PRESENT at rank 4, labelled, and RESOLVED at 0.8295 WITHOUT counting it — and corroborated the correction node in the same act. ONE HYPOTHESIS KILLED, by Law 9: the cast standing gate ('a hypothesis may not retire an earned node') would have left Akien's own correction unable to retire anything, since every node is BORN a hypothesis — the gate protecting the corpus from its author. Rebuilt on provenance AUTHORITY, an allowlist holding {'correction'}; the three named cases all still hold and a fourth now passes. Whether revisions HOLD under live use is the armed probe's question — already biting on its un-adjudicated condition, waiting on Akien for 3 verdicts.
